sdk_source_refs: SGGK topology deserialization for imported ABC SGT bodies
ABC STEP import artifacts from 40chunk run
test_goal: Drive a 100k+ loaded-SGT boolean recut campaign from imported ABC bodies, then produce a bug-only report that excludes explicit unsupported kernel responses.
risk_summary: Primitive booleans are too clean for distillation. Imported ABC topology combined with tolerance-band generated cutters can expose boolean split, imprint, empty-result, property, and TopoCheck failures at scale.

geometry.target_builder: loaded_sgt from imported ABC STEP result_*.sgt artifacts
geometry.tool_builder: solid_cylinder, sweep_circle_line, and extrude_rect generated by stress corpus recut
geometry.parameter_notes: Use stress preset: five tool/contact families, three boolean operations, and five tolerance bands per imported SGT. Fixed code targets 100000+ recipes and runs shardable subsets.

expected_behavior: Candidate bugs exclude explicit unsupported/not-allowed kernel messages. Remaining failures must include a triage fingerprint, representative case, validation/status evidence, and ABC source path.
notes: Use run_abc_boolean_mass_recut.py with --target-cases 100000 --preset stress and a shard-count suitable for the machine. Start with one shard smoke, then fan out shards.
